description: Google Tasks administration. tasklist_id defaults to "@default". Actions: create_task(title, notes?, due?, parent?, previous?, tasklist_id?), update_task(task_id, title?, notes?, due?, status?, tasklist_id?), complete_task(task_id, tasklist_id?), move_task(task_id, parent?, previous?, destination_tasklist_id?, tasklist_id?), create_tasklist(title). Destructive (confirm:true): delete_task(task_id, tasklist_id?), delete_tasklist(tasklist_id). due is RFC 3339 (only the date is kept by Google).

params.description: Action parameters; destructive actions also need confirm: true

name: tasks_admin
